title: Microvascular Monitoring in Circulatory Shock and Sepsis (MiMICSS)
official: Microvascular Monitoring in Circulatory Shock and Sepsis (MiMICSS): Prospective Observational Cohort Study
summary: Investigation of the feasibility of using near-infrared spectroscopy (NIRS) to monitor microvascular function in critically ill patients.

interventions.name: Skeletal muscle and cerebral NIRS (research device)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Admitted to ICU
* Receiving invasive mechanical ventilation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Body Mass Index \>40
* More than 24 hours has elapsed since ICU admission
* Death is deemed to be imminent and inevitable during the next 24 hours
* Known allergy to the textile components of the device
* Significant clinical jaundice, ecchymosis
* COVID positive microbiological result
* The treating clinician believes that participation in the domain would not be in the best interests of the patient
* Consent declined from patient or authorized third party
